terms.meaning: A way to answer behavior questions: describe the Situation, Task, Action, and Result.
A cap on answer length that a form may set.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and time limit
sections.what: Brings in the AI helper and allows 120 seconds for the request.

sections.name: FormQA
sections.title: Question and answer shape
sections.what: Describes one question with its answer.
sections.why: Gives a fixed format for the results.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Build the answers prompt
sections.what: Reads the profile and job context and writes a prompt containing the questions.
sections.why: Gives the AI facts to base answers on.
sections.watch_out: Only the first four experience entries and six achievements are used.

sections.name: POST (part 2)
sections.title: Writing rules and AI call
sections.what: Adds the writing rules (first person, no em dashes, respect word limits, JSON output), calls the AI, and returns the answers.
sections.why: Keeps answers consistent in tone and format.
sections.watch_out: Rule 8 asks the AI to put an error inside the answer list rather than fail, so callers must check for that.

summary: Writes answers to job application form questions using the candidate's profile and the job context.
why: Likely reason: saves time on repeated application questions.
how: Builds a profile summary, a job excerpt, and the questions into a prompt with writing rules. Asks the AI for JSON with question and answer pairs and returns them.
inputs: Questions text, optional job description excerpt, company name, role title, the profile, and provider settings.
outputs: A list of question and answer pairs, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: The AI may invent facts about the candidate. The rules say not to, but nothing checks the output. The questions text is cut at 4000 characters.
debug: An empty list: check the questions are clear. When the AI cannot find questions it puts an error message in the first answer.
